skills.name: Blur
skills.description:
Surround yourself in a phantasmic aura to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

skills.name: Dark Cloak
skills.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff3917|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Path of Darkness
skills.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

skills.name: Aspect of Terror
skills.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

skills.name: Summon Shade
skills.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff829|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Consuming Darkness
skills.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff16285|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.
